body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 11). The board's task detail (the `<solace-task>` element below the lanes) scrolls away with the page; the feature asks for it to be collapsible and to stick to the bottom.

- Add a collapsed state to the board model with a header bar that shows the selected task's title and a collapse/expand control; the detail area is a fixed band at the bottom of the board page.
- Expanding shows the full `<solace-task>` as today; collapsing shows the one-line bar.
- The lanes area takes the remaining height, so the page does not scroll to reach the detail.
- Selection, notices, and the column bar keep working with the detail band in place.

**Tests:** board view tests for collapsed and expanded states, and for the detail band's presence after selecting a card.
title: ui: Collapsible detail pinned bottom
